item.title: LLM Context Window Comparison: Largest Models (2026)
item.description:
Which LLM has the largest context window? As of October 2026, Meta’s open-weight Llama 4 Scout advertises the most, at 10M tokens. Among hosted APIs, the ceiling is about 1M tokens: OpenAI’s GPT-6 family lists 1.05M, and current Claude, Gemini 3.x, DeepSeek V4 and Grok 4.3 models list 1M. Max output ranges from 64K to 384K.

The rest of this page is a sourced LLM context window comparison: hosted models, open-weight models, what long prompts cost, and why the biggest number isn’t always the one to pick. If you want the basics first, read what the context window of an LLM is.

item.title: Best Chatbot for Memory: Which AI Apps Remember You
item.description:
The best chatbot for memory in 2026 is ChatGPT or Claude for most people. Both save facts about you, search your past chats, and let you see and edit what they keep, on free and paid plans. Gemini and Copilot remember too, with fewer controls. Character.AI is the pick for roleplay, but its memory is small and mostly manual.

What “memory” means in a chatbot

Chatbot memory is the ability to use information from earlier conversations in a new one. Without it, every chat starts blank. With it, the app stores facts you shared (your job, diet, a project) or searches old chats, then adds the relevant bits to the model’s input before it answers.
